<!--
  The simple rating (model rating@1): the score (large), the heading that names it, a line (the count, the
  scale) and the source as a link. Axes: layout (bar: one row on a card surface from md up, centered: centred,
  one under the other).
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type RatingSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  value: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  sourceLabel?: string;
  sourceHref?: string;
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  layout?: "bar" | "centered";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  value,
  title,
  description = "",
  sourceLabel = "",
  sourceHref = "",
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  layout = "bar",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<RatingSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const box = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "bar" ? "flex flex-col gap-4 rounded bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground border border-border md:flex-row md:items-center md:gap-8"
  : "flex flex-col items-center gap-4 text-center"
);
const copy = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "bar") ? "md:grow" : "");
const copyAlign = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "bar") ? "start" : "center");
const copyText = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "bar") ? "text-start" : "text-center");
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="rating-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Box :class="box">
        <Text size="5xl" weight="bold" class="tracking-tight text-primary">
          {{ value }}
        </Text>
        <Stack gap="2" :align="copyAlign" :class="copy">
          <Title :as="level" size="xl" weight="semibold" :class="copyText" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="sm" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', copyText)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <LinkPlain
          v-if="(sourceLabel && sourceHref)"
          :href="urlOf(sourceHref)"
          class="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
        >
          <Text size="sm">
            {{ sourceLabel }}
          </Text>
        </LinkPlain>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
